answer_1.quote: Tuning LLMs for dialogue generation has been the de-facto mainstream practice towards creating capable dialogue agents.

answer_2.quote: In addition to consistency, we also adopt commonly used automatic evaluation metrics for dialogue generation.

answer_3.quote: We also employ the state-of-the-art LLM, GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023), to automatically evaluate the score of dialogue consistency (GPT-4 Score), similar to existing works.
methods: an API call of GPT-4-turbo asking it to rate the consistency with an integer scale of 1 ∼ 10

answer_4.quote: We recruited three well-educated graduate students as the annotators to evaluate which one is better (or tied) from the dimensions of consistency (Consist.), proactivity (Proact.), coherence (Coh.), and target success rate (Succ.).
answer_4.guideline: Given a pair of dialogues produced by two variants of tuning for the same backbone model, we recruited three well-educated graduate students as the annotators to evaluate which one is better (or tied) from the dimensions of consistency (Consist.), proactivity (Proact.), coherence (Coh.), and target success rate (Succ.).
